        if (digits[i] >= w) {

            digits[i + 1]++;

            digits[i]++;

        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < l + 2; i++) {
        if (!(digits[i] == 0 || digits[i] == 1)) {
            works = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (works) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
